sloka: येन वैवस्वतो युद्धे वासवश्च पराजितः ।सैष विश्रवसः पुत्रः कुम्भकर्णः प्रतापवान् ।अस्य प्रमाणात् सदृशो राक्षसो ऽन्यो न विद्यते ।। ६.६१.९ ॥
transliteration: yena vaivasvato yuddhe vāsavaśca parājitaḥ ।saiṣa viśravasaḥ putraḥ kumbhakarṇaḥ pratāpavān ।asya pramāṇāt sadṛśo rākṣaso 'nyo na vidyate ।। 6.61.9 ॥

translations.english: "Vyvasvatha (Lord of death) as well as Vasava (Indra) were defeated by him in war. He is Kumbhakarna, the son of sage Visrava, a stupendous one and there is no other Rakshasa who equals him in size."
